[b]ERENE WORLD CUP 2028 MATCHDAY 1 GROUP STAGES![/b]

[Spoiler=USO vs ULR]The match begins of the first ever match of the 2028 world cup match against USO and ULR, with USO being the host of the tournament and playing in their brand new stadium, The Grand Stadium, against formidable opponents ULR being the third last tournament. The game first kicks off strongly, with ULR stealing two goals instantly in the 15th and 17th minute, one as a header from H. Masson, and a left footed strike from the center of the box in the bottom corner from M. Fannon. USO manages to score a penalty by their striker K.Theodore, though It unfortunately didn't slow down for USO as ULR score another goal from a free kick in the 23rd minute from P. Carmody, making it 1-3 in the first half, USO tries to defend until the end of the first half to slow down the Lavian players, the first half ends with the same score, already looking to be a one-sided game for ULR, the second half begins with ULR not stopping their advancement, as defender S. Sala manages to get a header into the top corner from a penalty, with A. Upton stealing a late goal in the 73rd minute from a right footed shot from the edge of the box, making it a big embarrassment for Oceanice, the game ends as 1-5 for ULR, with USO fans criticizing the team very badly after the match.

USO 1 - 5 ULR
Theodore 21⠀ H. Masson⠀ 15'
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ M. Fannon ⠀17'
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ P. Carmody 23'
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ S. Sala ⠀⠀⠀57'
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ A. Upton⠀⠀ 73'

Match summary: https://ibb.co/RpftLcjP
[/spoiler]

[Spoiler=Groldonica vs Italian Dutch]The match begins of the second ever match of the 2028 world cup match against Groldonica and Italia, a good matchup awaited by both fans, the game begins with Italia dominating, managing to score two goals in the first 36 minutes, with S. Ricci scoring both with one as a long range shot and a header, Groldonica tries to get on the game to get a goal, thoguh their chances of attacks were defended out by Italia's defense, with the first half ending into halftime. In the second half, Italia's attack doesn't slow down as F. Marino scores to make it three-nil for italia, Groldonica manages to steal a single goal by their midfielder in the 81st minute, yet end short as the game ends with a decisive win for Italian Dutch.

Groldonica 1 - 3 Italian Dutch
Player 6 21⠀   S. Ricci⠀⠀⠀ 27',36'
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ F. Marino⠀   62'

Match summary: https://ibb.co/Y7xv9gdd
[/spoiler]

[Spoiler=Nordiheim vs Valonia]The match begins with the third game of Matchday 1, against the first opponents in group B, Nordiheim and Valonia, with the stadium filled with fans, the game kicks off wih both sides playing similar styles, equal in defense and attack, with a few good chances from Nordiheim, and an open goal miss from Valonian striker Wilkinson, the first half ends with a goalless tie, not much to cover about it. The second half kicks off with Nordiheim playing more defensive tactics, opposite of the Valonian team that was now playing offensively, Valonia manages to get a goal early into the first half from a centered shot in the box by Wilkinson, making it one-nil for Valonia, Nordiheim not so later changes their tactics into a more attacking play, as they try to break through Valonia's defense, in the 71st minute, Nordiheim manages to get a goal by sub striker N. Lokisen put on a plate, making it 1-1, the game continues on with no goals to break the tie as the game ends with a 1-1 draw.

Nordiheim 1 - 1 Valonia
N. Lokisen 71  F. Wilkinson⠀55'

Match summary: https://ibb.co/HLP6dHBC
[/spoiler]

[Spoiler=Visgreria vs Tu'wi Republic]The last match of tonight begins with Visgreria and Tu'wi's national teams facing up, they kick off with good attacking play, though Tu'wi plays strong enough as they manage to steal two goals in a mater of two minutes, one scored by their winger from a curved shot in the 15th minute and the other a shot from the edge of the box by their attacking midfielder, Tu'wi then plays defensively, to ensure that no Visgrerian player manages to score, though, a goal will be scored by their striker Panova from a tight angle in the 21st minute, which will be the first and last goal for Visgreria for the game, as they don't manage to win or equalize against Tu'wi in the first and second half.

Visgreria 1 - 2 Tu'wi Republic

Before the Supreme State, there was a groldonica in Northeast Vespuria, and for thousands of years our ancestors lived and worked there. The capitalist republic of Groldonica, although multicultural, has a significant portion of its population originating from that area. This land, which is rightfully Groldonican, has been stolen from the Groldonicans. Therefore, the Foreign Ministry of Groldonica officially lays claim to this territory, as historical evidence proves that it is Groldonican.
